text:
alice: Heads-up — multiple kv-sync jobs failing in us-west-2, observed ~40% packet loss east-west between gpu-slices pods. Root cause looks like a NetworkPolicy change (default-deny) after the automation run.
ben: Which policy? any PR/automation change?
alice: automation job 'namespace-hardening' applied a NetworkPolicy to namespace 'gpu-slices' at ~09:12 UTC. It effectively blocks egress except to cluster-api/service CIDRs. Our pods use serviceaccount 'kv-sync' which was rotated to 'kv-sync-v2' by a separate script and wasn't in the allowlist.
carol: Confirmed. I ran `kubectl -n gpu-slices exec -it gpu-worker-0 -- ping -c 4 kv-store-0.gpu-slices.svc.cluster.local` -> 100% packet loss.
ben: Also seeing conntrack table skyrocketing on node gpu-node-03: `conntrack -S` shows 265k entries, threshold at ~262k, packets getting dropped at kernel level.
alice: Here's the problematic NetworkPolicy we found:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: default-deny-egress
  namespace: gpu-slices
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```
carol: Ouch. `egress: []` == block all egress. That explains inter-pod traffic drop.
dave: Quick mitigation: add an exception allowing kv components to reach kv-store pods and required cluster services. Proposed patch:
```
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-kv-egress
  namespace: gpu-slices
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: kv-sync
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress:
  - to:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kv-store
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 6000
```
Apply with `kubectl apply -f allow-kv-egress.yaml -n gpu-slices`.
ben: Also we should temporarily raise conntrack limit while we roll: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=524288` on affected nodes; I'll coordinate with SRE to push a daemonset if needed.
emma: I added a small canary to the netpol automation to include serviceaccount exceptions and to check for SA drift. Testing the patch now.
infra-bot: patch applied to gpu-slices/allow-kv-egress (rollout 1/2) :robot_face:
alice: After applying allow-kv-egress, I can see TCP handshake succeed from kv-sync -> kv-store, packet loss down to ~0-1%. kv-sync jobs started finishing.
ben: conntrack drops decreased after the temporary sysctl bump. We'll bake the change into the node image/cloud-init to prevent recurrence under load.
carol: Follow-up item: add unit test to the automation that verifies serviceaccount names referenced in allowlists exist and that netpols don't inadvertently become global deny without safelist entries.
dave: Also adding an alert for netpols with `egress: []` applied to non-system namespaces.
alice: OK to close for now; monitoring for 1h. Will open a short postmortem if it reoccurs. :thumbsup:
